name: Laravel 12 / React / Inertia / React Native
description: Classic web stack: Laravel 12 backend with Inertia 2 + React (TypeScript) pages (four-screen journey, session-cookie auth, fixed bounded algorithm workbench, /api/v1 JSON envelope with X-Request-Id correlation, failed-login throttle with 429 + Retry-After) implemented and tested (PHPUnit feature suite + real-HTTP smoke scripts for both the API and the CSRF-protected web flow); transport-agnostic TypeScript shared layer (envelope normalizer + API client) unit-tested with vitest and consumed by a React Native Expo thin shell written against the frozen envelope contract but NOT compiled or run (no Expo/Android/iOS SDK on this machine).
